text:
sam_sales: Quick sync 10x Health POC: they returned an order form + PO but legal redlined DPA requiring EU-only PHI + HSM BYOK. Need sign flow and whether PO+DocuSign OK.

leo_se: Short answer: Hosted doesn't support full BYOK atm. We can offer Dedicated (eu-west-1) with KMS integration or Private. Any preference from procurement?

ruth_procure: PO will be to '10x Health Solutions EU' net30. They prefer DocuSign. Billing contact: invoices@10x-health.eu.

eva_legal: BYOK + attestation requirement -> escalate to SOW for key import process and attestation. Also push back on 1-hour P1 SLA; suggest 4-hour response with credits.

mila_sec: Security: we can provide SCCs & SOC2. For HSM BYOK we need controls doc + key import runbook. I can draft the security addendum. ETA 24h.

sam_sales: Customer asked if we can do "hosted + their keys" to avoid Dedicated costs. Is a short-term workaround possible?

leo_se: Possible but risky: we could offer a temporary customer key-proxy (no HSM attestation) and mark it as transitional in the SOW. Legal might reject.

eva_legal: If they accept transitional controls and explicit acceptance that HSM attestation is pending, we can proceed with PO+DocuSign and a follow-up SOW for full BYOK. Need to capture acceptance language.

ruth_procure: I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope. Proposed recipient order: 1) 10x CFO (sign) 2) 10x legal (ack) 3) sam_sales (sales) 4) eva_legal (Redwood legal). Any objections?

mila_sec: No objections. I'll attach the security addendum draft once ready.

ds-sign-bot: DocuSign envelope created by ruth_procure at 2026-05-14T09:12Z  envelope id: ds_10x_abc123

sam_sales: Great, please post redline summary + security Q answers here when ready and I'll push to the customer.
